CHAPTER 8 · ITEM 09 / 13

Tax size, time and subsidies

Tax size and the Laffer curve稅額與拉弗曲線

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Trace how an increasing unit tax affects quantity, revenue and DWL; interpret the Laffer curve and recognize that tax revenue need not always increase when the tax rate rises.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

加稅通常減少交易並增加 DWL；收入為 t×Q(t)，稅更高時數量收縮可能抵消稅額增加。線性內部解下 DWL 隨 t 的平方增加。

A larger tax generally lowers quantity and raises DWL. Tax revenue equals t×Q(t), so the higher rate can eventually be outweighed by fewer transactions. With linear curves and interior trade, DWL grows quadratically in t.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：If Q(t)=100−t, revenue=t(100−t); t=20 yields 1,600, t=50 yields 2,500, t=80 yields 1,600. 稅額太高可能少收。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

For Q(t)=100−t, which tax maximizes revenue? 哪個稅額收入最高？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
